text:
Hard Rock Stadium mepere na August 16, 1987, mgbe ọ nabatara egwuregwu preseason mbụ ya. Ewubere ya na ego iwu nke $115 million ma chepụta ya site na HOK Sport, ụlọ ọrụ a maara ugbu a dị ka Populous, ọ malitere dị ka Joe Robbie Stadium, aha ọ nwere ruo 1996. Site na mmalite ọ bụ ụlọ nke NFL's Miami Dolphins, ụlọ obibi ejidere kemgbe 1987.

Ọdịdị ebe ahụ agbanweela nke ukwuu. Site na nkwekọrịta ikike aha ọ ghọrọ Pro Player Park na Pro Player Stadium, mgbe ahụ Dolphins na Dolphin Stadium, Land Shark Stadium, Sun Life Stadium na obere oge New Miami Stadium, tupu ọ kwụsị na Hard Rock Stadium na 2016. Ndị bi na ya agbasawanyekwara: ọ bụ ụlọ MLB's Florida na Miami Marlins site na 1993 ruo 2011, ndị meriri 1997 na 2003 World Series n'ebe ahụ; ọ nabatala Miami Hurricanes na bọọlụ kọleji kemgbe 2008 na asọmpi tennis Miami Open kemgbe 2019. Ala egwuregwu bụ Tifway 419 Bermuda grass.

Àgwà ama egwuregwu gbanwere site na nrụzigharị 2015-2016, nke onye nwe ya Stephen Ross kwadoro n'onwe ya. Ọrụ ahụ gbakwụnyere bọọdụ vidiyo nkuku na swiitị ndị ọzọ ma kpuchie ebe ahụ site na ihe mkpuchi mepere emepe, nke spaya nkuku anọ kwadoro, na-ekpuchi ihe ka ukwuu nke ebe oche. Ọrụ ahụ belatara ikike site na ihe dị ka 75,000 mbụ ruo ihe dị ka 65,000.

Na mgbakwunye na ndị bi na ya na bọọlụ, ama egwuregwu ahụ emela ụfọdụ nnukwu ihe omume nke egwuregwu America, gụnyere Super Bowls isii na ọtụtụ egwuregwu mmeri mba bọọlụ kọleji. N'afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya ọ wulitela ezigbo akwụkwọ bọọlụ mba ụwa, na-anabata 2024 Copa America Final na egwuregwu 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, gụnyere Al Ahly 0-0 Inter Miami opener. Maka 2026 FIFA World Cup, a na-akpọ ama egwuregwu ahụ nwa oge Miami Stadium n'okpuru iwu aha ebe dị ọcha nke FIFA. Ọ ga-anabata egwuregwu asaa: egwuregwu otu anọ, otu Round of 32, otu ọkara ikpeazụ, na egwuregwu nke atọ na July 18, 2026.
